channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: The gaps in the implementation of the RTI Act
item.description: Section 4 of the RTI Act lists 16 types of information which are to be disclosed by public authorities; such voluntary disclosure has not been followed

item.title: Anti-CEC protests LIVE: Supreme Court to hear pleas challenging closure of metro stations in Delhi on Oct. 13
item.description: Opposition stalwarts, joined by activists and civil society members, undertook a “March for Democracy” on a heavily barricaded route and filed a joint petition against SIR and alleged poll irregularities in Delhi

item.title: IISc study says strong magnetic fields could allow white dwarfs to grow beyond the Chandrasekhar limit
Drought report: On southwest monsoon, drought in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
item.description: The Centre must help States once inter-ministerial team gives finding

item.title: Deep conspiracy to bring in ultra-leftist mindset: Fadnavis slams Congress as ‘anti-constitutional’
item.description: Congress wants to create anarchy in the country. It is a conspiracy to undermine the Constitution written by Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar and the institutions created by him, says Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis

item.title: Keralam Senior Citizens (Care and Protection) Bill to focus on protection of rights, dignity of elderly
item.description: The Bill that will be tabled in the Assembly on October 13 also aims at promoting active ageing, regulation of senior citizen care centres, and capacity-building for family and caregivers

item.title: Display rates of healthcare services prominently, Centre tells States
item.description: Clearly visible display will enable patients to take informed decisions, build trust, prevent billing-related disputes; Health Ministry also urges clinical establishments to display package rates for international patients visiting India on medical and Ayush visas

item.title: RLM suspends Ram Pukar Sinha, MLC candidate backed by three rebel party MLAs
item.description: On October 5, Ram Pukar Sinha filed the nomination as an independent candidate for the upcoming Legislative Council election in Saran Teachers Constituency

item.title: Arlekar new full-time Governor of T.N., Sudha Yadav to take charge in Karnataka in new gubernatorial appointments
item.description: O.P. Mathur to now serve as Governor of Keralam; Braj Mohan Ram to be Governor of Odisha, Dhal Singh Bisen Governor of Uttarakhand and former BJP general secretary Dushyant Gautam Governor of Sikkim

item.title: Winning, differently: On the by-election results in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
item.description: Ruling parties sweep by-elections, but defections mar Tamil Nadu results

item.title: Berlin to BITS Pilani: How Nobel-winning optogenetics connects to parasite research in Hyderabad
item.description: Light has become more than a means of observation; it is a way to intervene, test, and uncover cause-and-effect relationships, said Nishith Gupta, professor of Biological Sciences at BITS Pilan

item.title: Mehbooba Mufti opposes motorable boulevard on western side of famous Dal Lake
item.description: Why destroy Nigeen Lake’s tranquillity? Kashmir needs ecological protection, not divisive politics, says PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti

item.title: Restrictions on firecrackers: Supreme Court urges balance between religious sentiments and public health
item.description: Justice Joymalya Bagchi questions religious basis for bursting firecrackers; CJI cautions against restrictions which cannot be enforced on the ground, says people should be educated to reject harmful cracker varieties

item.title: Delhi police accused of beating, assaulting detainees, denying them basic rights
item.description: Detainees report being transported in ‘prison vans’, verbally and physically abused, denied water; one group taken to isolated police camp, seated in rows, and systematically beaten by police after their phones were confiscated

item.title: Demolition of tribals’ houses in M.P. draws Shivraj’s anger; says ‘Mohan ji became CM with their votes’
item.description: On October 11, houses of about 12 tribal families in Kosmi village were demolished by the Forest Department over alleged encroachment

item.title: Delhi protests against CEC: What the law says about preventive detention | Explained
item.description: The Supreme Court directed the Union government and the Delhi Police to stop illegal detentions and allow free and smooth movement of people and traffic, as well as the operations of Metro and rail services, but “subject to law and public order”

item.title: Police crack down on anti-SIR protesters in Bengaluru, detain 100
item.description: The police threatened journalists covering the protest and ordered them to leave the spot, while three photographers were manhandled, despite repeatedly identifying themselves as members of the Press.

item.title: Post against CJI: KPCC president says person responsible for X post removed from party position
item.description: The Congress party had no differences of opinion regarding the impartiality of the courts, Mr. Joseph said

item.title: West Bengal bypolls proved that BJP does not draw support from just one community: CM Suvendu
item.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had earlier said that 80% of the Muslims in Nandigram and 60% of the minority population in Rejinagar had voted for the BJP in the bypolls held on October 6

item.title: SIR needed every five years to check influx: Assam CM
item.description: Himanta Biswa Sarma cites the demographic shift in four eastern States to drive home his point

item.title: Bombay HC orders accused in Goa fire case to deposit interim compensation of ₹20 lakh each
item.description: The Court directed that the “deposit would be subject to final contentions in the main matter”

item.title: J&K Waqf Board pushes for uniform Friday sermons, ‘preachers’ committee to decide topics in advance’
Speaker rejects objection over the use of ‘Kerala Niyamasabha’ for official purposes
Govt. move to de-notify Jantar Mantar follows SC suggestion that protest sites need more space, open air
item.description: A four-page court order passed on October 9 records the Supreme Court Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant urging the government to look for a ‘spacious, open’ alternative site in Delhi

item.title: Karnataka will continue with probe into efforts to illegally delete names of genuine voters, says Chief Minister
item.description: The Chief Minister said lakhs of Form 7 applications, seeking deletion of names, had been withdrawn after cases were filed against those who were misusing such a mechanism to get the names of genuine voters deleted

item.title: Kannur Corporation introduces double-decker bus for sightseeing during Dasara
item.description: Organised through the Kannur Corporation and KSRTC’s Budget Tourism Cell, the service will operate for 10 days, allowing residents and tourists to enjoy colourful illuminations and festival decorations in the city. Its continuation will depend on public response.

item.title: Police to step up surveillance on airport stretch in Keralam’s Kochi
item.description: The stretch covering areas including Athani Junction and Airport Junction has come under heightened surveillance following the car-two-wheeler collision that claimed the lives of three youths on October 11.

item.title: Amicus curiae visits P&T Apartment Complex, to submit report to High Court on October 16
Kerala HC directs Social Justice Directorate to disburse pending financial aid to transgender person
item.description: Court allows petition, which sought a payment of ₹21,000, with an interest of 18% per annum, pending from a total payment of ₹36,000

item.title: Samithi opposes private estate group’s land offer for Wayanad medical college
item.description: M. Geethanandan, social activist and general convener of the Bhoo Avakasha Samithi, demands that the government take over all plantations allegedly held through forged documents and distribute the land among the landless

item.title: Abdullapurmet Tahsildar, surveyor caught accepting ₹20 lakh bribe in Rangareddy district
Rural police crack down on illegal moneylending, four booked
item.description: The raids were conducted at 42 locations across the rural police district

item.title: India poised to woo global investments amid US curbs: INMECC
item.description: Urging the Central and State governments, along with private-sector stakeholders, to explore the emerging opportunity, the INMECC said it is actively engaged in facilitating investment opportunities in India.

item.title: 13,505 girls get HPV vaccine in Kozhikode
The Hindu Downtown announces MoC Kolu Kondattam 2026 contest
Investigation reveals collection of ‘party fund’ during Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi’s tenure as School Education Minister, CCB tells Madras High Court
item.description: It makes the submission in a counter affidavit filed before Justice V. Lakshminarayanan in response to the former Minister’s plea to quash the FIR against him

item.title: VCK tries to pre-empt TVK’s potential bid to rope in PMK
Interim zone of influence around Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers, State Wetlands Authority tells Madras High Court
item.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan decide to pass orders on October 14, 2026 regarding restriction of interim ZoI to 128.19 hectares

item.title: Nominations open for 25th CavinKare Ability Awards 2027
item.description: Nominations are invited under two categories

item.title: Upper Bhadra water release acquires electoral overtones in Karnataka
item.description: The experimental water release from September 6 has triggered a political debate, with the Opposition alleging an electoral motive.

item.title: Karnataka gets its second woman Governor with appointment of Sudha Yadav
Doval speaks to Iran NSA, discusses ‘latest developments’ after ships attacked in Hormuz
item.description: Two Indians are still missing following the attack on two ships on Sunday; the IRGC Navy has issued warnings against merchant vessels switching off the automatic identification system to evade detection

item.title: YSRCP to focus on digital outreach, organisational strength for local body polls in A.P.
item.description: Sajjala instructs various wings of the party to identify alternative candidates for every seat

item.title: Low pressure over Bay of Bengal may bring rain to Andhra Pradesh from October 15
item.description: All three regions of the State may receive moderate showers from October 15 to 19, says IMD

item.title: Don’t fully scrap tax officers’ arrest powers, Keralam tells 57th GST council meet
item.description: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, who attended the 57th council meet, had argued that strong deterrence measures were required for tackling large-scale and organised tax evasion

item.title: Andhra Pradesh RTI Commission earns national recognition for speedy case disposal
item.description: The Commission has disposed of 7,034 cases between January and September 2026, compared with 3,252 cases in 2024 and 3,326 in 2025, says State Chief Information Commissioner Vajja Srinivasa Rao

item.title: ‘One website for one local body’ implemented, says Keralam Minister K.M. Shaji
item.description: Dedicated official websites have been readied for 941 grama panchayats, 152 block panchayats, 14 district panchayats, 87 municipalities, and six Municipal Corporations, which will publish local body profile, details of people’s representatives and officials, Budget, development schemes, information, decisions, reports, tenders, citizen services

item.title: Vijayawada Mayor post declared ‘Unreserved General’ as per 2026 reservation allocation
Congress Seva Dal seeks case against Bhaskar Rao over ‘fake news’ on Dhruv Rathee
item.description: In a representation dated October 10, Junaid P.K., president of the Brigade, alleged that Mr. Rao had created doubts about Mr. Rathee’s nationality by suggesting that he could be a foreign national.

item.title: ADNOC open to further long-term LPG deals with India, sees India among most important energy markets: Acting CEO, Marketing
item.description: ADNOC supplied more than 500,000 barrels of crude a day to India in 2025, “almost one in ten barrels of [India’s] crude imports”. The company is exploring opportunities with ISPRL to expand storage of crude oil, LNG and LPG, including strategic reserves

item.title: INDIA bloc marches through Delhi, takes SIR protest to Supreme Court
item.description: Opposition presents a united front amid heavy police deployment but little interruption; Congress says 2.5 lakh people took part in the four-hour-long ‘March for Democracy’; most protesters Congress supporters who travelled from across the country

item.title: Vijay to meet A.P. CM on Godavari-Cauvery linking project
Deputy Speaker inaugurates SEIL-funded water project in Undi constituency
Constable carries woman’s body for a kilometre after retrieving it from river
item.description: The constable with Mantrayalam police found the body of a woman who allegedly ended her life in the Tungabhadra river floating in the waters, carried it on his back for nearly a kilometre through hilly terrain, before reaching the shore

item.title: Seer held on charge of sexually exploiting woman on promise of marriage
item.description: The case was registered on October 8, based on a complaint by the victim.

item.title: Over 3.85 lakh cases pending in 28 information commissions as of June 2026: report
item.description: The ‘Report Card on the Performance of Information Commissions in India, 2025-26’ says the number of appeals and complaints pending on June 30, 2026, in 28 information commissions stood at 3,85,716; in 2025, it was 4,13,972

item.title: CJI: ‘Child in conflict with law’ describes circumstance, not identity
item.description: The CJI said 10 years is a short time for a statute, but it is more than half of a childhood

item.title: Justice Nagarathna flags gaps in implementation of Juvenile Justice Act at National Annual Stakeholders Consultation
item.description: Justice Nagarathna said the focus should not be limited to disposing of cases. The system must also ensure that children receive education, counselling, medical care and legal assistance while their cases are pending.

item.title: Dinesh Kumar takes charge as 12th PRC Chairman
Why does India need a trained workforce for elderly care?
item.description: India’s 60-plus population is projected to touch 347 million by 2050, underscoring the need for a robust caregiving ecosystem; a formal training programme, building on existing small-scale initiatives, could promote gender parity in caregiving and recognise informal, unpaid family caregivers
